description: Maps Pi serial numbers to friendly node names. Serial is printed on the board sticker (last 8 chars).
workflow: 1. Look at Pi board sticker - note last 8 characters of serial
2. Add mapping here: serial -> friendly name
3. Print label with friendly name, stick on Pi enclosure
4. Flash Pi with generic cloud-init, deploy to location
notes: Or run on Pi: cat /proc/cpuinfo | grep Serial
If hostname is customized, that takes precedence over serial
